reasoning: This V-shaped bouncing arrow is the standard Android/Material icon for a missed call (and occasionally bounce/rebound). While a phone handset is clearer for general calls, this glyph specifically fits tasks about returning missed calls or handling bounced messages, though out of context some users may mistake it for a checkmark or abstract directional arrow.

pass1.ambiguity: Strongly resembles a backwards checkmark or a generic UI directional arrow if the viewer is not familiar with phone call log icons.

distinguishing: The V-shaped arrow travels from top-right down and bounces up-left (arrowhead on the left), representing a standard incoming missed call or a backward bounce, whereas its mirror image bounces up-right.
